title: Can We Choose Another Day?
summaryZh: 銜接「討論週末計畫」：婉拒原本的時段、提出另一個日期與時間，最後確認雙方相同的約定。

learning.objectiveZh: 聽懂婉拒與時間變更，提出可行的替代方案，並確認最後的日期、時間與地點。

vocabulary.en: To eat the meal in the middle of the day.
To need to work because it is necessary.
A suggestion to choose Sunday instead.
To arrange an agreed time in this context.
vocabulary.example: Could we make it one thirty?

vocabulary.en: To meet at that place rather than the first place.

task.titleZh: 換個條件：星期日下午喝咖啡
task.setupZh: 朋友邀你星期六下午三點去同一間咖啡店，但你星期六要工作。你星期日下午三點半可以；請婉拒、提出調整並確認約定。

steps.partner: Would you like to have coffee on Saturday at three?
steps.promptZh: 婉拒星期六，說明你必須工作。
steps.sample: I'd love to, but I have to work on Saturday.

steps.promptZh: 表示星期天可以，並提出下午三點半。
steps.sample: Sunday works. Could we make it three thirty?

steps.partner: Sure. Let's meet at the cafe.
steps.promptZh: 確認星期日三點半在咖啡店碰面。
steps.sample: Great. Sunday at three thirty, at the cafe.

success: 我有婉拒原時段並說明原因。
我有提出星期日下午三點半。
我有確認日期、時間與地點。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Would you like to have lunch on Saturday?
sentences.zh: 你星期六想一起吃午餐嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I'd love to, but I have to work.
sentences.note: I'd love to, but ... 先表達願意，再說明這次不行。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Let's meet at twelve outside the station.
sentences.zh: 我們十二點在車站外碰面吧。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Could we make it twelve thirty?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sure. Do you know the cafe across the street?
sentences.zh: 可以。你知道街對面那間咖啡店嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes. Could we meet there instead?
sentences.zh: 知道。我們可以改在那裡碰面嗎？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Good idea. Sunday at twelve thirty, at the cafe.
sentences.zh: 好主意。星期天十二點半，在咖啡店。

questions.explanationZh: 朋友說 I have to work，星期六必須工作。
原本是十二點，後來改成 twelve thirty，最後再次確認十二點半。
雙方把地點改到咖啡店，最後在第 9 回合確認。
